excluded_source_emissions.reason: LNHB supplies absolute L- and K-family Auger totals but only energy ranges and relative family information, not a complete conditional line or continuous energy law. LARA/PenNuc supplies no such law. These nonzero emissions are outside this selected model; MIRD remains an independent cross-check and is not substituted as an atomic authority.
Annihilation photons belong to positron transport, not parent source groups. No source annihilation pair is selected.

EC shell probabilities are not source emissions. Relative atomic intensities are not additional absolute yields. Internal-pair conversion coefficients alone do not supply a complete particle energy law; no pair or zero-energy placeholder is inferred.

No neutrino, recoil nucleus, later daughter-decay emission, or unobserved upper-limit branch is added. Selected nuclear transitions and atomic emissions are independent prompt source marginals; level lifetimes and coincidences are not modeled.

provenance.capture_role: Independent audit of evaluated EC branches and shell probabilities; no invented photon/electron yields. fixint=1 is retained exactly where specified.

ENSDF.interpretation: S. Ota and E. A. McCutchan, NDS 203, 1 (2025), cutoff April 1, 2025: 3.3492(6) d, Q=600.8(19) keV, beta intensities 68.6(4)% and 31.4(4)%, and gamma 159.381(15) keV at 68.3(4)%. LNHB gives 3.3485(9) d, 68.5(5)% and 31.5(5)%, and 159.373(12) keV at 68.1(5)%.

MIRD_MIRDsoft.role: Independent cross-check only. The retained CSVs do not establish an evaluation identity or half-life. DPK files are dose-deposition kernels, not source-emission probability laws.

source_disagreements: LNHB tables retain older LOGFT beta means 142.8(7) and 204.2(8) keV. BetaShape 2.4 gives 142.0(7) and 203.3(8) keV, consistent with the more recent ENSDF means. The selected continuous laws are the retained BetaShape 2.4 calculated spectra.
MIRD detailed atomic and conversion inventories have different line granularity and yields from the selected LNHB inventory. They are not added, averaged, or used to close an energy or yield balance.
